question: A ______ is a group of people who come together to contest elections and hold power in the government.
solution:
The correct answer is a __**political party.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **A political party is a group of individuals who come together to contest elections and hold power in government.**
 
• Political parties have a shared ideology or set of beliefs that guide their policies and decision-making.
 
• The members of a political party work together to promote their agenda and gain support from voters.
